messages:
maya: Heads up — saw a retry stampede on the eval-runner for the quant-onboard job. Single shard blown up, tons of immediate retries :exclamation:
ci-bot: [alert] eval-runner/job/quant-onboard-2024-11-29 failed 46x in 4m, avg_retry_delay=0ms, concurrent_workers=120
arjun: can you paste the tail logs? guessing hot shard + zero-delay retry loop.
maya: log dump:
```
2024-11-29T15:22:01Z worker-12 ERROR dispatch failed shard=11 err=KVCacheMiss retry=1
2024-11-29T15:22:01Z worker-13 ERROR dispatch failed shard=11 err=KVCacheMiss retry=2
2024-11-29T15:22:01Z worker-14 ERROR dispatch failed shard=11 err=KVCacheMiss retry=3
2024-11-29T15:22:01Z worker-15 ERROR dispatch failed shard=11 err=KVCacheMiss retry=4
```
samira: pattern matches earlier incidents — warmup/kv miss on quantized models. The scheduler immediately requeues so all workers hammer same shard.
jen_ops: two immediate mitigations: 1) add exponential backoff + jitter in eval-runner retries; 2) per-shard in-flight cap (token-bucket) to stop hot-shard amplification.
kai: For CI let's reduce default parallelism for quant bring-ups; the harness is spawning 50 reps by default which is the shotgun.
arjun: proposing minimal runtime change: cap retries to 3, backoff = base*(2**attempt) + rand(0, jitter_ms), and scheduler should check shard_in_flight before assigning.
```
retry_delay = base_ms * (2 ** attempt) + random(0, jitter_ms)
if shard_in_flight[shard] >= per_shard_limit:
    requeue_after(100ms)
```
maya: add telemetry tags: retry_count, shard_id, outcome=(succeeded|aborted|retried) so we don't skew pass@k when partial batches drop.
samira: partial-run filtering was biasing median latency and pass@k. we need events for aborted vs retried vs success at shard granularity.
arjun: opening PR for jitter+retry cap, and a follow-up to lower CI parallelism for quant jobs. will run staging tonight.
ci-bot: [deploy] eval-runner patch/1987654321-jitter rolled out to staging at 2024-11-29T20:05:12Z
maya: re-running blocked quant job once staging green. @samira can you watch pass@k and shard retry rate? if any shard >5% retry we abort the job.
samira: watching. also adding short-term fallback: if retry_rate >10% for a shard, mark degraded and route those examples to fallback (non-quant) runner to avoid noisy baselines.
ci-bot: [info] staging run finished, retry_rate_shard11=1.9% — metrics stable
maya: follow-ups: 1) prod rollout with per-shard token-bucket; 2) add telemetry tags for retry/aborted; 3) default CI parallelism for quant onboarding reduced
kai: updating runbook with new triage steps and adding dashboard card for per-shard retry histograms. will also add alert when shard retry percentile > 5%.
